"Jatha, a film focusing on caste issues, was shelved despite its promising start. The soundtrack was composed by Deva, with all lyrics penned by Vairamuthu. The song 'I Like You' is copied from 'I Feel Lonely' by German singer Sasha.

In the Bible, Abraham is commanded by God to sacrifice his son Isaac. After binding Isaac to an altar, a messenger from God stops Abraham before he can complete the sacrifice, stating 'now I know you fear God'. Abraham then sees a ram and sacrifices it instead. This event is said to have occurred at 'the mount of the LORD'.

In music, Speakerboxxx/The Love Below by OutKast was released in 2003, selling over 500,000 copies in its first week and becoming certified Gold by the RIAA. The album's fourth single, 'I Do' featuring André 3000 and Jay-Z, peaked at No. 61 on the Billboard Hot 100.

In the world of motorcycles, Kymco, a Taiwanese manufacturer, released the Kymco Grand Dink 125 in 2004. The Grand Dink 125 is a maxi-scooter with a 125cc engine and a top speed of 65 mph.

In literature, author J.K. Rowling's debut novel, Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone, was published in 1997. The book introduces the character of Harry Potter and the magical world of Hogwarts.

In mathematics, the concept of proof is crucial. As mathematician G.H. Hardy wrote in A Mathematician's Apology, 'There is no permanent place in the world for ugly mathematics.' Proof is the process of demonstrating the truth of a mathematical statement through a series of logical steps.

In the world of theater, the play 'Fully Committed' by Becky Mode was reviewed positively. The Broadway production received more mixed reviews. The show features frequent breaking of the fourth wall and meta moments, leaving audiences to question its aims."
